sample_unit: AI-generated outputs (plus 15 healthcare professionals and 54 patients)
models_evaluated: Patiently AI (LLM-based medical note simplification app)

links.outcome: Readability of AI-simplified medical notes versus original notes (FKGL, Flesch Reading Ease, Gunning Fog)
links.effect: FKGL decreased 2.96 levels (10.57→7.61); Flesch Reading Ease rose 31.9 points (37.7→69.6); Gunning Fog fell 4.09 points (14.5→10.4); child 4.25 grade reduction vs adult 1.80.
links.quote: AI-generated explanations showed significant readability improvements: mean Flesch–Kincaid Grade Level decreased by 2.96 levels (10.57→7.61), Flesch Reading Ease increased by 31.9 points (37.7→69.6), and Gunning Fog Index decreased by 4.09 points (14.5→10.4).

unlisted_practices: Audience-specific (child, teenager, adult, carer) and tone-adapted LLM personalization of medical note explanations

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of Patiently AI, an LLM mobile application for simplifying medical notes, involving computational readability analysis, expert safety/accuracy ratings, and patient preference surveys in an offline/simulated setting.
